text:
Sam (AM): Heads-up 10 Atlas signed an MOU. They're proposing a 3-week POC to serve a proprietary 7B variant (merged LoRA) over their private S3 with strict egress controls. Primary asks: confirm model catalog fit, ingestion steps, and an initial Dedicated pricing estimate.

Liam (Atlas): Hi all 10 our artifact is a merged safetensors checkpoint, GPT2-BPE style tokenizer (tokenizer.json), 2k context but typical sequences are 512. We need CCAR-level logging and data never persisted outside their VPC.

Iris (SE): Noted on egress and logging. We can do a VPC-only Dedicated lane with customer CMK. For the model: safetensors + tokenizer.json is fine. We'll validate for custom attention or nonstandard layer names.

Noah (ML Eng): Quick validation plan:
- ingest and schema check: ~30m
- tokenizer token-set check & sample tokenization: ~30m
- architecture scan for custom ops: ~1-3h
- benchmark single-GPU perf (no quant): ~1h
- optional int8 pass + eval: ~3h
If all green, preflight can close same day.

Rina (Solutions): For presales pack I'll request: 1) security questionnaire answers, 2) 25 representative prompts + golden responses, 3) latency & throughput targets, 4) any compliance notes (PCI/HIPAA). I'll attach our standard POC T&Cs (30-day retention by default).

Sam (AM): Can we give them a conservative Dedicated monthly bracket? They asked for <150ms p95 at 12 concurrent qps.

Iris (SE): For a 7B merged model at that SLO 12 qps, likely 1-2x A100 equivalents depending on batching. Ballpark monthly commit range: $A--$Bk. I'll refine after we run a throughput sim with their seq stats.

Noah (ML Eng): Use this internal check command once upload is complete:
```
model-checker run --src s3://atlas-poc/model/merged.safetensors --tok s3://atlas-poc/model/tokenizer.json --report /tmp/atlas-1957654321.json
```
It outputs compatibility flags and a perf baseline.

catalog-bot: Ingest job scheduled 11 job=61190, ETA ~90m.

Liam (Atlas): Uploading now and will share read role. Also: we store LoRA deltas in a separate bucket historically; for this POC we merged them but can share unmerged if helpful.

Noah (ML Eng): Good to know. Merged is simplest for serving. If you later want adapter hot-swap we can accept separate deltas but need placement metadata.

Rina (Solutions): Quick Q: any restrictions on telemetry? They asked for CCAR logging but no raw input logging. We usually offer redacted logs and hashed telemetry. Liam ok with hashed prompt traces only?

Liam (Atlas): Hashed traces are fine. No raw prompt retention outside the VPC.

Noah (ML Eng): Initial scan summary (catalog-bot uploaded):
- tokenizer: PASS (tokenizer.json present, vocab matches sample prompts)
- topology: PASS (decoder-only, no custom attention)
- perf baseline: ~140ms p95 @ 12 qps with micro-batching enabled on int8 path
- flags: NOTE -> sequence length distribution skewed to short (<128) which helps batching; int8 quality delta within 1.5% on our checklist

Iris (SE): Those perf numbers look doable. I'll prepare the Dedicated onboarding doc and an IAM policy snippet for the read role.

Rina (Solutions): Sending the presales packet to Liam with the questionnaire and our POC SOW draft. Also asked for the 25 prompts and the gold responses.

Sam (AM): Next steps:
- Liam: confirm IAM role and telemetry ok (Liam)
- Noah: finalize perf sim + cost sim (Noah)
- Iris: VPC/Dedicated onboarding doc + SLO estimate (Iris)
- Rina: send questionnaire & SOW (Rina)

Liam (Atlas): IAM role shared. Proceed. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

catalog-bot: Perf sim complete 11 sim_id=61190, report: s3://rw-reports/61190-atlas-1957654321.json

Noah (ML Eng): Perf & cost sim uploaded. Short summary: meeting <150ms p95 at 12 qps on int8 with a small Dedicated pool; monthly commit estimate: $Ck-$Dk depending on reserved term. I'll attach numbers in the CRM.

Sam (AM): Great. Liam 10 we'll send a formal quote after Rina's SOW aligns. Tracking as Atlas POC ref: AT-87. Thanks team, reconvene after the POC kickoff meeting.
